request.subject: PORTRAIT:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only his shield and sleeves: the crimson shield with the gold lion becomes a small plain round wooden shield of pale brown planks with a steel rim and a round steel boss, no lion and no paint; his chainmail sleeves become plain cream linen sleeves. Do not redraw anything else: keep the helmet with its gold band and crimson crest, the face, the sword, the crimson tunic with the gold cross, proportions, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
